in_sanskrit.name: भास्कर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Bhaskara is derived from the Sanskrit word 'भास्' (bhaas), which means 'to shine', and 'कर' (kara), which means 'doer' or 'maker'. The name Bhaskara can be translated as 'bringer of light' or 'shining one'.
